title: Pan-Seared Fish with Stew Vegetables
description: A flavorful and nutritious dish made with pan-seared fish and sautéed stew vegetables, perfect for a quick dinner.

ingredients.name: Fish fillet
ingredients.notes: Choose a mild-flavored fish like cod or tilapia

ingredients.name: Stew vegetables
ingredients.notes: Choose snappy vegetables like carrots and snap peas

ingredients.name: Dutch seasoning
ingredients.notes: Add a pinch of Dutch spice to give it a local flavor

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the fish fillet with salt and pepper.
Add the fish to the skillet and sear for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
While the fish is cooking, heat the Dutch seasoning in a separate pan.
Add the stew vegetables to the pan and sauté for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
Serve the pan-seared fish with the sautéed stew vegetables.
Garnish with kissed (such as chopped fresh herbs) to taste.
